mapper.select: SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{projectId})
mapper.sql: a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') + interval '1 month') AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')
mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,a.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,a.asgn_se_cd, a.asgn_stts_cd,m.mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest(to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'),a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true WHERE ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.asgn_id
SELECT e.expns_id,e.dev_id,e.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,e.expns_amt FROM cst.drct_expns e LEFT JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=e.prj_id WHERE e.expns_ym=#{month} ORDER BY e.expns_id

WITH stages AS ( SELECT l.prj_id,max(CASE l.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 3 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS rank FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l GROUP BY l.prj_id ) SELECT l.prj_id,l.dev_id,sum(m.aloc_amt)::bigint AS aloc_amt FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN stages s ON s.prj_id=l.prj_id AND s.rank=CASE l.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 3 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth m ON m.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id AND m.aloc_ym=#{month} WHERE l.line_ty_cd='PERSON' AND l.dev_id IS NOT NULL AND (l.asgn_se_cd IS NULL OR l.asgn_se_cd!='FREE') GROUP BY l.prj_id,l.dev_id ORDER BY l.prj_id,l.dev_id

SELECT c.cst_ym,c.dev_id,c.asgn_id,c.prj_id,c.aloc_ty_cd,c.mm_qty,c.tot_mm_qty,c.aloc_rt, c.lbr_cst_amt,c.drct_expns_amt,c.sls_amt,c.bill_untprc_amt,c.mm_ovr_yn,c.free_sprt_yn,c.pre_cntrct_yn FROM cst.cst_aloc c WHERE c.cst_ym=#{month} ORDER BY c.dev_id,c.asgn_id NULLS LAST,c.prj_id NULLS LAST,c.cst_aloc_id

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE AND a.prj_id=#{projectId} UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.cst_ym=#{month} AND c.indv_lbr_cst_amt!=0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=c.dev_id AND a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND )
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.expns_ym=#{month} AND e.expns_amt!=0
AND (e.prj_id=#{projectId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=e.dev_id AND a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND ))
)
